conditional_research_verdict: Accept with Revisions for problem investigation only

required_fields.important_failure: Not yet observed in real generated data. Proposed failure: generated reference groups sharing a nonroot branch might reinforce common error during anchored revisits. S21/S22 real-photo metrics cannot establish it; S19 old-coordinate-overwrite premise remains rejected.
required_fields.falsifiable_hypothesis: Same-branch AAA/BBB versus complementary ABA/BAB at same anchor, three cameras, four condition slots. Null/negative predictions and ordinary similarity/quality explanations are retained.
required_fields.nearest_prior_art: Five fixed-version primary papers and nine queries, four axes in idea.md section4 and sources.json.papers; no complete survey claim.
required_fields.mechanism_difference: Actual reference-group composition intervention with individual-frame marginals balanced; no new selection algorithm yet. Without the proposed intervention, no ancestry claim follows from source logs. Generic quality/dedup controls and incompatible-world alternatives are essential.

allowed_at_reference_selection: real initial anchor available from task start
all branch images and producer latents/embeddings generated before selecting the revisit conditions
available reference and target cameras and intrinsics
predeclared branch RNG and current generator settings
forbidden_for_selection: future revisit output pixels or latents
revisit reconstruction loss or scoring labels
legal_inputs.score_boundary: Known initial RGB is a legitimate shared anchor in every arm and a revisit reference, not a hidden novel-view target. Any sensor/independent perceptual scoring is separate and cannot change reference selection. Prior TUM test exposure remains disclosed.

required_fields.minimal_discriminating_test: idea.md section5: four true history sampling calls, four paired final calls plus at most one ordinary-policy extra call; fixed count/cameras/anchor/noise; report positive, null, failure and untestability separately. Not frozen or run.
required_fields.fairness_and_completeness: Same current generator identity, condition count, precision, cameras, target sampling settings and balanced individual-reference marginals. All planned branches/failures preserved; costs included. No actual new-generation manifest/compatibility/runtime receipt exists.
required_fields.decision: Defer execution while exact VMem main/VAE resources and real closed-loop evidence are absent. Retain narrow revised question; reject old coordinate-overwrite mechanism and unqualified source-diversity claims.
required_fields.local_feasibility_and_downstream: Current work is read-only source/literature evaluation. Future exact pipeline.py get_cond -> sampling -> actual latent/embedding storage interface must be validated, followed by original two-navigation batches, then the controlled reference assembly. No runnable generation command supplied because exact main/VAE inputs are unavailable. Lyra2 is only an explicitly named alternative, metadata accessible but CUDA/H100 requirements unverified on M3; never silently substitute.
required_fields.independent_confirmation: Exploration on new legal physical starts with fixed seeds; independent scenes separate from pilot and already-viewed TUM desk for confirmation. Neither new list nor sample size is frozen. No blind-test or generalization result claimed.

gate_status.G0: Question/explicit real-test plan only; important generated failure unobserved
